text..hero-sub: Drivers find and reserve open spots in seconds with live IoT data. Parking Admins manage spaces, monitor occupancy and grow revenue from a single dashboard.

text..drivers-section .section-sub: Cut the time you spend hunting for a spot. SpotGo brings real-time availability and one-tap reservations to every driver - pricing and plans are defined by each parking admin, so you always see local rates upfront.
text..p-admins-section .section-sub: Manage every space from one dashboard. Define your own pricing, subscription plans and access rules - then monitor occupancy, classify users and grow revenue per spot.
text..pricing-section h2: Transparent for drivers, flexible for Parking Admins
text..pricing-section .section-sub: Drivers always see local rates upfront - set by each parking admin. Parking Admins choose a SpotGo platform plan that fits their portfolio.
text..driver-card-left h3: Pricing is set by each parking admin
text..driver-card-left > p: SpotGo does not sell driver subscriptions. Hourly rates, monthly passes and discounts are defined by each parking lot, so you always pay the local price - no surprise fees from us. Compare options on the live map and reserve in seconds.
text..rates-note: Rates shown are examples. Actual prices are set by each parking admin.
text..testimonials-section h2: Loved by drivers, trusted by Parking Admins
text..cta-inner p: Drivers find spots faster. Parking Admins run lots smarter. Pick your side and get started in minutes.
text..team-section .section-sub: Five Software Engineering students building SpotGo — combining different strengths, stacks and perspectives to make smart parking happen.
text..footer-tagline: Smart parking for modern cities. Real-time, reliable, reserved.
text..footer-made: Made with care for drivers everywhere.
